title: Forward-looking evolutionary game dynamics subject to exploration cost
summary: We extend classical evolutionary game dynamics based on the momentary action choices of agents by accounting for two elements: forward-looking behavior and exploration cost. We focus on pairwise comparison protocols that cover major evolutionary game dynamics, such as replicator and logit models. In the proposed mathematical framework, agents update their actions by paying a cost so that a utility or its relative difference is maximized.
